newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivorian cocoa product exports rise in April.
newsitem.headline: Ivorian cocoa product exports rise in April.

text.p: Ivory Coast's semi-finished cocoa product and powder exports rose in April to 8,123 tonnes from 6,530 tonnes in March, official shipping data show.

Cumulative exports in the first seven months of the 1996/97 (Oct-Sept) season -- including shipments from October 1 to October 24 when the season opened -- were 55,346 tonnes against 34,728 in 1995/96.
Ivory Coast has brought more processing capacity on line since 1995/96, with the total now standing at just over 160,000 tonnes.
The data do not separate liquor, butter and cake exports but powder shipments from Abidjan totalled 809 tonnes.
Cumulative powder shipments stand at 4,117 tonnes this season against 3,227 tonnes the year before and just 49 in 1994/95 -- before most processing capacity came on line.

Ivory Coast's cocoa bean processing capacity of 160,000 tonnes by the 1996/97 season is set to rise in 1997/98 as the government encourages investors to build processing plants to add export value. --Matthew Bunce, Abidjan newsroom + 225 21 90 90
